name: Unitas
oneLiner: USDU is Unitas's delta-neutral synthetic dollar: long JLP hedged by short perps via Copper/Ceffu, with permissionless USDC mint/redeem on Solana and BSC.
collateral: Live Accountable reserves split across Binance off-exchange/perp margin and on-chain Solana/BSC reserves; ~10% of protocol fees route to an Insurance Fund
pegMechanism: Overcollateralized, delta-neutral: long JLP + short perpetuals rebalanced hourly via Copper/Ceffu off-exchange settlement; mainnet mint/redeem against USDC is permissionless on Solana and BSC, with the DAO retaining optional KYC/KYB gating powers
